units.source: Software engineering at Google has been an extraordinary experiment in how to develop and maintain a large and evolving codebase. I’ve seen engineering teams break ground on this front during my time here, moving Google forward both as a company that touches billions of users and as a leader in the tech industry. This wouldn’t have been possible without the principles outlined in this book, so I’m very excited to see these pages come to life.

units.target: 谷歌的软件工程是一场非凡的实践，探索如何开发并维护庞大且不断演进的代码库。在谷歌工作期间，我见证了工程团队在这一领域不断开拓，推动公司前进：既服务数十亿用户，也引领科技行业的发展。这些成就离不开本书阐述的原则，因此，看到这些经验汇集成书，我格外欣喜。

units.source: If the past 50 years (or the preceding pages here) have proven anything, it’s that soft‐ ware engineering is far from stagnant. In an environment in which technology is steadily changing, the software engineering function holds a particularly important role within a given organization. Today, software engineering principles aren’t simply about how to effectively run an organization; they’re about how to be a more respon‐ sible company for users and the world at large.

units.target: 过去50年的发展，包括本书前面的内容，至少说明了一点：软件工程远非一成不变。在技术持续演进的环境中，软件工程在组织内承担着尤为重要的职责。如今，软件工程原则不只关乎如何有效运作一个组织，也关乎企业如何对用户和整个世界更加负责。

units.source: Solutions to common software engineering problems are not always hidden in plain sight—most require a certain level of resolute agility to identify solutions that will work for current-day problems and also withstand inevitable changes to technical systems. This agility is a common quality of the software engineering teams I’ve had the privilege to work with and learn from since joining Google back in 2008.

units.target: 常见软件工程问题的解决办法，并不总是显而易见。多数时候，需要灵活而果断地探索，找到既能解决眼前问题，又能经受技术系统不可避免变化的方案。自2008年加入谷歌以来，我有幸与许多软件工程团队共事，并向他们学习；这种应变能力正是他们共有的品质。

units.source: The idea of sustainability is also central to software engineering. Over a codebase’s expected lifespan, we must be able to react and adapt to changes, be that in product direction, technology platforms, underlying libraries, operating systems, and more. Today, we rely on the principles outlined in this book to achieve crucial flexibility in changing pieces of our software ecosystem.

Today, we rely on the principles outlined in this book to achieve crucial flexibility in changing pieces of our software ecosystem.
units.target: 可持续性也是软件工程的核心。在代码库的预期生命周期内，无论产品方向、技术平台、底层库还是操作系统发生变化，我们都必须有能力应对和适应。如今，正是本书阐述的这些原则，让我们在修改软件生态系统的各个部分时，保有至关重要的灵活性。

units.source: We certainly can’t prove that the ways we’ve found to attain sustainability will work for every organization, but I think it’s important to share these key learnings. Soft‐ ware engineering is a new discipline, so very few organizations have had the chance to achieve both sustainability and scale. By providing this overview of what we’ve seen, as well as the bumps along the way, our hope is to demonstrate the value and feasibility of long-term planning for code health. The passage of time and the impor‐ tance of change cannot be ignored.

units.target: 我们当然无法证明，这些实现可持续性的方法对每个组织都有效，但分享其中的关键经验依然重要。软件工程是一门年轻的学科，很少有组织有机会同时实现可持续性和规模化。通过介绍我们的观察及一路遇到的困难，希望能够展示：为代码健康作长期规划，既有价值，也切实可行。时间的推移，以及变更的重要性，都不容忽视。

units.source: This book outlines some of our key guiding principles as they relate to software engi‐ neering. At a high level, it also illuminates the influence of technology on society. As software engineers, it’s our responsibility to ensure that our code is designed with inclusion, equity, and accessibility for everyone. Building for the sole purpose of innovation is no longer acceptable; technology that helps only a set of users isn’t innovative at all.
units.sourceHtml: This book outlines some of our key guiding principles as they relate to software engi‐ neering. At a high level, it also illuminates the influence of technology on society. As software engineers, it’s our responsibility to ensure that our code is designed with inclusion, equity, and accessibility for everyone. Building for the sole purpose of innovation is no longer acceptable; technology that helps only a set of users isn’t innovative at all.
units.target: 本书概述了指导我们开展软件工程的一些关键原则，也从更宏观的角度说明了技术对社会的影响。作为软件工程师，我们有责任在代码设计中考虑所有人的包容性、公平性和无障碍需求。只为创新而开发，已经不可取；只能帮助部分用户的技术，根本算不上创新。

units.source: Our responsibility at Google has always been to provide developers, internally and externally, with a well-lit path. With the rise of new technologies like artificial intelli‐ gence, quantum computing, and ambient computing, there’s still plenty for us to learn as a company. I’m particularly excited to see where the industry takes software engi‐ neering in the coming years, and I’m confident that this book will help shape that path.

units.target: 谷歌始终有责任为内部和外部开发者提供清晰的前进路径。随着人工智能、量子计算和环境计算等新技术兴起，公司仍有许多需要学习的东西。我尤其期待，未来几年业界会把软件工程带向何方，也相信本书能为这条道路的形成贡献力量。
